profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Mastercard
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in Spring Boot, Java, and Algorithms. Strong engineering professional with a Master’s Degree focused in Computer Science from New York Institute of Technology.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
-Worked on a client location ( Verizon wireless, Georgia)
- Created REST APIs using the spring framework.
- Used Hibernate to perform database-related operations.
- Used AWS services to deploy the application.
- Used Jenkins as a CI/CD pipeline.

positions.title: Software Developer (Java-SpringBoot) Contract
positions.description:
-Created RESTful APIs for increased scalability of the application.
-Utilized frameworks such as Hibernate and Spring Boot for persistence and application layers.
-Used Git for version control and JIRA for the task management of the project.
-Create and execute test cases in JUnit for unit testing of an application.

positions.title: Graduate Assistant
positions.description:
-Under the direction of faculty, managed all lab operations and tracking of instrument use and availability for students. 
-Provided instructional and technical assistance to students/faculty and assisted with planning and coordinating activities.

positions.title: Software Engineer Internship
positions.description:
-Implemented live score sports application particularly for Cricket using Spring MVC, Hibernate Used MySQL database for data storage and developed UI using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, and JSON
-Implemented DAO layers using JPA standards and Hibernate API interfaces and integration with Spring Framework. 
-Developed a RESTful service to provide all the CRUD capabilities.

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.description:
- Developed a web application for employees to perform daily functionalities
- Automated the organization's processes making them hassle-free
- Implemented the web application using technologies HTML, JavaScript, Java-J2EE and SQL

certifications.name: Oracle Certified Associate, Java SE 8 Programmer
certifications.title: Oracle Certified Associate, Java SE 8 Programmer

honors.title: Excellent Project
honors.description: Secured first position for excellent project work (Industry Automation) in Project Fair among IT department conducted by AIT.

projects.title: OmniFood(Restaurant Website)
projects.description:
- Designed a responsive website for a restaurant
- Implemented features like menu selection, location tracking, and home-delivery using HTML, CSS3 and JavaScript

projects.title: CACHE SIMULATOR
projects.description: - Developed a java program to simulate a simple cache using 2 way set associative and direct mapping
